first.rationale: Verify the onboarding result because the current completion decline is directly actionable and onboarding is a durable lever for adoption and qualified revenue. Verify promotional pricing because competitor entry pricing makes it consequential, but its prior acquisition lift may not establish sustainable revenue quality or margin. Pending verification, simplify onboarding is the intended experiment because it directly addresses both declining completion and activation without relying on discount-driven demand.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. The verified result directly addresses the 4% completion decline and supports sustainable downstream value: completion increased 13%, time-to-value fell 2.1 days, and 30-day retention increased 3%. Promotional pricing is not selected despite competitive pressure because its verified 40% discount improved short-term signup and qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12% and failed to survive the first renewal cycle. Monitor activation, qualified conversion, retention, and revenue quality to ensure the simplified flow does not admit or accelerate low-fit accounts.
